answer: Admission is one public assay window. The claimant locks 1.21 POA for seven epochs and welds a 28-byte relic chip to the bond hash plus window index. Across 40 hours they hang three signed mirror plates of a live task counter, each at least 10 hours after the last and from a distinct /40. Three unclustered assayers recompute a crystal fold over the chip, the bond, and the three plate clocks on the live tip. A missed hang costs 0.062 POA. Two windows funded from one wallet in 85 minutes, or a recycled relic stem, slashes 44 percent of every linked bond and shutters that window for four epochs.
